definition: to hit something with a sharp blow
description: Three young men with white blindfolds sit in a row on concrete blocks in a red dirt yard, with a fourth man watching from a chair beside them. A big blue water bottle hangs from a rope above them and is pulled back and released, swinging down the line like a pendulum. It sweeps past the first two and slams into the third man, who is knocked backwards off his block with his legs in the air. He picks himself up and sits back down, and all four laugh.

taps.target: the man in the navy shirt
